note: Moments Jay judged (27 Nov) - dev/scenarios.py checks the scoreboard picks what he'd pick. Frame: a = m from our goal, l = m across (our left minus); mates [a, l, role]; opps [a, l].

moments.name: thinking_1 top: LCM in midfield
moments.jay: ST2 is surely his best option

moments.name: thinking_1 bottom: RM on the right
moments.jay: into ST1's feet, or a through ball - (27 Nov: Jay's happy enough with the scoreboard's answer, not much in it)

moments.name: thinking_2 top: ST2 at the edge of the box
moments.jay: shoot, or dribble at the last defender

moments.name: thinking_2 bottom: LM wide in their third
moments.jay: 1v1 at his man if a good dribbler > pass to LCM > cross to the edge

moments.name: thinking_3 top: RCM free in his own half
moments.jay: not a carry towards 11 players: turn / carry towards the LCM, then LCB switches it, or ping it to the LM himself - (27 Nov: Jay's happy enough with the scoreboard's answer, not much in it)

moments.name: thinking_3 bottom: RM on the right, halfway
moments.jay: about right - carry inside, then maybe a pass to the RCM

moments.name: thinking_4 top: ST1 in space by the box
moments.jay: perfect - carry into the box

moments.name: thinking_4 bottom: RM free near the box
moments.jay: not the pass to ST2, he's marked: carry towards the corner of the box to drag the LB across

moments.name: moment 7: RM by the byline
moments.jay: okay, as long as he crosses after the carry

moments.name: moment 9: LCB being pressed
moments.jay: ST1 along the floor, hit hard - or over the top to ST2 if he's an exceptional passer (over the heads of ~3 men) - (27 Nov: Jay's happy enough with the scoreboard's answer, not much in it)

moments.name: moment 10: LCM facing his own goal
moments.jay: perfect (pass to the LB)

moments.name: moment 11: RM, counter-attack
moments.jay: a through ball to ST2 - he's got past his defender, and the RM has a man behind him trying to tackle him

moments.name: moment 12: LB, chance to switch
moments.jay: could be a through ball, but the carry looks okay

moments.name: moment 13: striker, back to goal
moments.jay: okay (ST2) - but the LCM should score closer, he's in better space

moments.name: moment 14: edge of the box
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 15: winger 1 v 1
moments.jay: seems alright

moments.name: moment 16: in our own box
moments.jay: carrying is still okay - he can pass once he's progressed and drawn the opponent (or the pass to the LM)

moments.name: moment 17: centre-back, nobody pressing
moments.jay: looks fine

moments.name: moment 18: holding midfielder under heavy pressure
moments.jay: the right answer - but the LB shouldn't be an option at all: he's almost directly behind him, and so is the defender

moments.name: moment 19: full-back pressed by his touchline
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 20: winger, full-back overlapping
moments.jay: a small carry inside might make space for the LB, but a straight carry is okay too - (27 Nov: Jay's happy enough with the scoreboard's answer, not much in it)

moments.name: moment 21: long-range shot chance
moments.jay: carry makes sense - he can maybe get 1 v 1 with the keeper

moments.name: moment 22: midfielder with time
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 23: near the byline
moments.jay: ST1 and ST2 should both be valued very high - beyond their markers: a cross / ball just in front of them; the carry's only okay if we still get a chance, the defenders will get back

moments.name: moment 24: striker in the box
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 25: centre-back with time, average passer
moments.jay: an average passer: the LCB is the best option - (27 Nov: Jay's happy with the scoreboard's answer; long-pass accuracy parked)

moments.name: moment 25b: the same, a great passer (Van Dijk)
moments.jay: a very good ball-playing centre-back like Van Dijk hits the LM here - (27 Nov: Jay's happy with the scoreboard's answer; long-pass accuracy parked)

moments.name: moment 26: winger on a counter
moments.jay: fine

moments.name: moment 27: centre-back, no pressure, average passer
moments.jay: (the LCM - fine for an average passer) - (27 Nov: Jay's happy with the scoreboard's answer; long-pass accuracy parked)

moments.name: moment 27b: the same, a great passer
moments.jay: a great passer can easily hit the RB or even the RM with all the time and space

moments.name: moment 28: winger pressed by the corner flag
moments.jay: perfect if it's a lofted through ball (it is - whipped over the man pressing him)

moments.name: moment 29: midfielder pressed from behind
moments.jay: great

moments.name: moment 30: striker through on the keeper
moments.jay: fine

moments.name: moment 31: full-back in midfield
moments.jay: great - he can let the RM close him, then pass to his LM

moments.name: moment 32: midfielder in their third
moments.jay: looks fine

moments.name: moment 33: centre-back pressed by their front line
moments.jay: if the pass can get through, the LM is best - otherwise turn out, then the LCB (average passer: play it safe)

moments.name: moment 33b: same, a top passing centre-back
moments.jay: if the pass can get through, the LM is best

moments.name: moment 34: striker dropping deep
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 35: winger 1 v 1, space behind the full-back
moments.jay: tricky - a take-on isn't too bad if it comes off; a through ball to ST2 if it's on

moments.name: moment 35b: same, a top dribbler
moments.jay: a take-on isn't too bad if it comes off

moments.name: moment 36: defender on the edge of his box, pressed
moments.jay: perfect

moments.name: moment 37: wide man on the far side
moments.jay: perfect - needs his team-mates to move

moments.name: moment 38: striker holding it up, pressed
moments.jay: fine

moments.name: moment 39: just won it back in midfield
moments.jay: wrong - he can't reach the RB, there's a man on that side: it'd have to be the RCM

moments.name: moment 40: striker 20-35 m out, back to goal
moments.jay: the LM only with a lofted pass - otherwise ST2 or the LCM
